cases.question: 2026年8月青禾的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数、月内复购率是多少?

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when monthly_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_buyer_count end AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_14
) subq_15

      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
